verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a code-review and PR-management platform, but the pack never documents selecting many items and acting on them at once. The Triage actions are described per pull request ("Review, repair, reassign, merge, close, and follow a pull request"). The cross-repository queue, filters and saved views only organize items, and org-wide central configuration and glob path instructions are adjacent configuration features rather than bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
